title: White-Ground Lekythos (Oil Vessel): Winged Figures
tombstone: White-Ground Lekythos (Oil Vessel): Winged Figures, c. 500–490 BCE. Greek, Attic. Ceramic.
description: Known as "white-ground" because of the white clay slip applied as a surface for painting, this lekythos held perfumed oil for funeral offerings. The winged figures are shown in flight above a field of palmettes.

inscriptions.inscription: Graffito on underside of foot: ζωιλος [owner's mark]

title: Statue of an Athlete
find_spot: Said to have been excavated at Kerch
tombstone: Statue of an Athlete, 1–100 CE. Italy, Roman. Marble.
description: This idealized athlete recalls Greek sculptural types invented and popularized during the 400s BC. Large-scale athletes were originally created as sanctuary dedications and later copied by Roman sculptors.
creditline: Purchase from the J. H. Wade Fund
